channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Woman charged with trying to poison Haines City man: PCSO
item.description: An Orlando woman was arrested on Aug. 27 after Polk County deputies said she tried to poison a Haines City man, possibly several times, officials said.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Consumers urged to toss recalled sprouts over E. coli, Salmonella concerns
item.description: Everything Sprouts expanded a recall of Robust Radish Sprout Mix sold in Minnesota and Wisconsin over possible E. coli and Salmonella contamination.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tony Romo pleads no contest to Milwaukee OWI charge
item.description: CBS Sports analyst Tony Romo pleaded no contest to an OWI charge after his Milwaukee arrest, citing pain medication dependence and alcohol use.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Woman needed dozens of stitches after being attacked by otter while swimming in Lake Tahoe
item.description: A woman in Nevada says a routine morning swim in Lake Tahoe turned into a frightening encounter when an otter attacked her underwater.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 37 percent of Americans say they've gone to sleep hungry because of money issues
item.description: A survey of more than 2,000 Americans found 52 percent have cried because they didn't have enough money.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] USF Bulls set to kick off another exciting football season
item.description: Rob Higgins, USF’s CEO of Athletics, stopped by Denis Phillips Live to talk about the upcoming season, the progress on their new on-campus stadium, and more.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Persistent financial adversity may be having an impact on your brain
item.description: Consistently having to deal with financial adversity may be having an impact on your health. That's according to a recent study published by in the journal Innovation in Aging.

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Plant City police investigating shooting at Taco Bell restaurant: PCPD
item.description: Plant City police were investigating a shooting at a Taco Bell restaurant on Monday, officials said.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Rescuers saved some 80 people in Grand Canyon floods that left 2 dead and 1 missing, officials say
item.description: Two Texas men have been identified as flood victims after a deadly flash flood swept through the Grand Canyon. One person is still missing. Here's what we know.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Consumer confidence is slipping, with many worried about future income
item.description: Consumer confidence is slipping away, according to a new report from the National Association of Manufacturers. According to the association, confidence decreased 0.8 points in August to 89.4.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] US launches new Iran strikes after attacks in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The United States announced Tuesday that it was striking Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps targets in Iran.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Apple's new CEO, John Ternus, takes over from Tim Cook after 15 years
item.description: John Ternus officially becomes Apple's CEO today, succeeding Tim Cook after 15 years. He inherits a $4.6 trillion company navigating AI competition, supply chain pressures and shifting trade policy.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Two-thirds of Americans are avoiding food categories after recalls. Here's what's changing.
item.description: Two-thirds of Americans distrust food brands after recalls. An expert explains what's changing and what you can do now.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Undocumented immigrant who moved last year was hit with a $1.8 million DHS fine
item.description: Hector “Alessandro” Negrete got the phone call nine months after he moved to Guadalajara, Mexico, hoping for a fresh start without the onerous weight of uncertainty and fear he carried in Los Angeles.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Gov. DeSantis, Byron Donalds plan Tampa reunion as Democrats navigate socialism split
item.description: Florida's primary winners are working to turn former rivals into fall allies, with Republicans and Democrats launching separate unity efforts as the November general election comes into focus.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Bay Area dengue cases rise to 33 as mosquito spraying ramps up
item.description: Locally acquired dengue fever cases in the Bay Area have climbed to 33, prompting mosquito control agencies in Hillsborough and Pinellas counties to ramp up surveillance, inspections and spraying, according to the Florida Mosquito Control Association (FMCA).

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] SoHo neighbors, businesses at odds ahead of $93M flood relief vote
item.description: The city of Tampa is preparing to move forward with the South Howard Flood Relief Project, a major infrastructure overhaul designed to address chronic flooding in the South Howard business and residential area.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Bound by books and love: Bartow couple celebrates 50 years in business, 60 years married
item.description: In downtown Bartow, Bartow Christian Books and Gifts has become more than a small bookstore. For nearly 50 years, Bo and Sandy Raulerson have built it around faith, service and relationships.
